payload.description:
As a dashboard user, I want an announced command to be claimed and reported through a provider-neutral worker lifecycle, so that execution behaves consistently across deployment targets.

Feature: Portable command lifecycle
  Scenario: A worker completes an announced command
    Given an announced command with no active execution lease
    When an eligible worker claims and executes the command
    Then exactly one active lease identifies that worker
    And progress is visible through the control-plane task
    And the task reaches a completed terminal state
    And transport-specific result storage is not required
payload.title: Workers claim and report commands through a portable lifecycle
